summary: Accepted DS2 lanes are mapped to dependency-safe main release slices without bulk-merging feature/search-core. Hotel/room, selected-tour and post-success lead handoff are already released. Remaining Search 2.0 must be rebuilt on current main in two stages: dormant assets first, then an explicit activation slice with browser/visual/deploy evidence. The factual DS2 footer depends on the active ds2-search.css layer and must not be released ahead of that activation.
evidence: PR #739 released only hotel-details-design.css + room-details.css to main; no JS/search/lead contract change.
PR #743 released the accepted selected-tour hierarchy to current main while preserving newer main fuel/incomplete-price safeguards.
PR #745 released only the post-success lead handoff JS to main; lead persistence/transport and field mapping stayed unchanged.
feature/search-core Search 2.0 uses v2/ds2-search.css directly, while current main still uses the legacy CSS bundle composition.
feature/search-core loads v2/search-redesign-v2.js and v2/ds2-results-filters.js; current main does not contain those active Search 2.0 runtime modules.
PR #748 repaired Search 2.0 ownership to the active ds2-search.css layer; PR #755 added the missing active ds2-results-filters.js dependency to the task boundary.

PR #742 restored factual footer content and >=44px primary mobile community/app targets. PR #751 made the five-width gate render the real site-footer-v1.php component; Fast CI, Security and 375/430/768/1024/1440 visual evidence are green.
Current main site-footer-v1.php still uses the prior v2-site-community/at-site-footer composition, so replacing it before ds2-search.css activation would create a styling dependency gap.

release_slices.rule: Add/rebuild these accepted assets on current main without referencing them from index.php or bundle-manifest-v1.php yet. Do not replace unrelated main runtime files.
release_slices.done_when: Assets exist on main but are dormant, protected contracts are untouched, and no user-facing runtime path changes.

release_slices.rule: Rebuild the approved Search 2.0 activation against current main instead of copying feature/search-core wholesale. Preserve all newer main Tourvisor/search lifecycle, stale-response, selected-tour price/fuel, Metrika and lead-contract behavior. Activate ds2-search.css and the two accepted Search 2.0 JS modules, then switch to the factual DS2 footer only in the same dependency-complete slice.
gates: targeted browser QA for initial search, progressive 25→100, local narrowing, server re-search on widening, sorting, empty/recovery and counters
targeted selected-tour smoke to prove existing room/flight/price/lead flow remains intact
visual QA at 375px and 1440px; add 430/768/1024 only for affected breakpoint transitions
release_slices.done_when: Current main renders the approved Search 2.0 + factual DS2 footer with accepted behavior and no protected-contract changes.

explicitly_excluded: bulk merge or bulk cherry-pick of feature/search-core
external lead transport or field mapping
next_action: Create SEARCH2_DORMANT_ASSETS from current main as the next SAFE implementation slice. Only after it is green, build the MEDIUM activation PR on top of current main and run the targeted browser/visual/deploy gates.
